play.action: four-frame one-shot impact, designed to remain unmistakable when the 1536-pixel cell is displayed only 100 pixels wide over a #10131c game screen: frame 1 is a fully opaque warm-white shaft 48-72 pixels wide descending from the top; frame 2 connects it to a 220-pixel-wide impact flare at bottom-centre; frame 3 keeps the shaft and expands a connected hard-edged spark crown to 320 pixels; frame 4 removes the shaft but retains a bright connected 160-pixel ember crown. No needle-thin beam, tiny residual flecks, faint haze, or translucent-only light. The impact point stays fixed and the sides stay empty.

style: bold high-contrast impact effect matching the accepted base image; thick fully opaque warm-white shaft and connected hard-edged sparks with crisp clean edges, restrained fringe only, no pixel art, no dark outline, no palette reduction
